title: Partitioning an $S$-packing coloring into broadcast dominating sets
summary: Given a graph $G$ and a positive integer $k$, a packing $k$-domatic coloring of $G$ is a function $f: V(G) \to \{1,\ldots,t\}$ such that (1) for any color $j \in \{1,\ldots, t\}$ and any two distinct vertices $u,v\in V(G)$ with $f(u)=f(v)=j$ we have $d_G(u,v)>j$, and (2) $V(G)$ admits a partition into $k$ sets $A_1,\ldots,A_k$ such that for any $v\in V(G)$ and any $i\in\{1,\ldots,k\}$ there exists a vertex $w\in A_i$ such that $d_G(v,w)\le f(w)$.
